label: Best months
value: June to September; peak June to August
quote: Summer (April–September): This is the best time to visit.

label: From Kalam
value: About 40 km, about two hours by 4×4
quote: The journey from Kalam to Mahodand Lake is approximately 40 kilometers (25 miles).

label: The road
value: Rocky, narrow jeep track with stream crossings past Matiltan
quote: Rocky, narrow jeep track with stream crossings

label: Jeep fare
value: PKR 12,000–15,000 per jeep in July–August; 7,000–9,000 in June and September
quote: PKR 12,000 to 15,000 per jeep in peak season

label: Winter
value: The lake freezes and snow closes the track
quote: The lake freezes solid, and heavy snowfall makes it inaccessible.

label: Where to stay
value: Kalam is the base for the trip
quote: Kalam town is the base for the Mahodand run.

label: At the lake
value: Boats for hire; brown and rainbow trout
quote: This Lake is home to both brown and rainbow trout.
